decision.title: XSLT without XPath's predeclared prefixes (packet 4.24)
decision.summary: XSLT expressions see only the applicable static namespaces and xml, as the 4.0 draft gives them, so undeclared xs, map or math prefixes now raise XPST0081 or XTSE0280 unless fixed-namespaces declares them.

body.p: , after , , . A behaviour change for users. found that stylesheets saw XPath's predeclared prefixes (xs, xsi, fn, map, array, math, err) through sxml's XPath static context. The newest XSLT 4.0 draft (qt4cg, fetched 2026-10-20) gives an XPath expression in a stylesheet the applicable static namespaces of its containing element as its statically known namespaces (5.3.1, for static expressions too, 9.7, and xsl:evaluate's target expression, 10.5.1): the module's fixed namespace bindings when its root has fixed-namespaces, else the element's native namespace bindings (3.1). xml is always in scope. The 4.0 addition is fixed-namespaces (3.6.1): #standard or a conventional prefix (xsl, xml, xs, xsi, fn, math, map, array, err) binds the reserved namespace, but only when the stylesheet says so; nothing is predeclared. As and direct, the draft is the default:

item.p: The internal XPath static context has omits_predeclared_namespaces (src/xpath_static_internal.h; no public header changes); XSLT's static contexts, static expressions and xsl:evaluate set it, and prefix lookup then knows only the configured bindings and xml. XPath and XQuery keep their predeclared prefixes (XPath 4.0, 2.2.1; XQuery 4.0, 2.1.4). The XSLT functions taking names as strings (function-available, element-available, type-available, system-property) and the streamability analysis resolve likewise.

For users: a stylesheet that writes xs:integer, map:get or math:pi() without declaring the prefix now fails with XPST0081 (in an expression or an as sequence type) or XTSE0280 (in a name attribute such as ); before, it ran. Declare the prefix (xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema", with exclude-result-prefixes="xs" where literal result elements would copy it) or write fixed-namespaces="#standard". CHANGELOG says so.

Every stylesheet sxml ships declares what it uses: the book's page.xsl and customers.xsl (and its templates chapter explains it), five unit-test files, the bindings' test stylesheets. README, apps/sxml/README.md, the CLI goldens and tests/cli already did.

Left: a cast of a string to xs:QName at run time (src/cast_lexical.c) still falls back on the predeclared prefixes in every language, because the evaluator does not know the language of the code running; in XSLT xs:QName('fn:x') resolves where the draft would raise FONS0004. No suite case tests it.

Verified (): the debug preset, the xslt, cli and xpath_static tests, clang-tidy, the book check, and the whole XT40 suite with the release driver, case by case: 12,156 to 12,157 passed (120 wrong error), 362 to 361 failed, 0 errors, namespace-6202 from failure to pass, no case lost.

sources.source: XT40 passes, whole suite, case by case, before and after
